Countdown initiated.|A-Cee, before self-destructing|audio=ACeeSelfDestruct-DFSftE.flac|<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire audio drama">[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> a '''skirmish''' between [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Star of Empire]]''. When the Imperial [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] [[Kyle Katarn]] decided to defect to the Alliance, [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Dol Donar II]] dispatched the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Slyder]] and several Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to bring in Katarn and kill the Rebel agents who were conspiring with him. However, Katarn and the agents [[Jan Ors]]. [[Rosco Ross]], and [[Ris Waller]] were able to escape aboard the ship ''[[Truly Sorry]]''. Their [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[A-Cee]], however, was captured by Slyder on the ''Star of Empire'' and was brought to Donar. The governor didn't want to risk losing the rebels, and decided to chase them on his [[Dol Donar's yacht|yacht]], bringing along Slyder, his son [[Nathan Donar III]], A-Cee, and several others. When a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] attempted to reactivate A-Cee, the droid recognized Nathan's [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]]. Having been programmed to self-destruct at the sight of said uniform, A-Cee verbally announced his imminent [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruction]], much to the Imperial's horror. Thoroughly displeased with the Imperials, Slyder [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Donars before A-Cee destructed, destroying the Donar yacht and allowing the rebels to escape.<ref name="SotE" />
